name: ESO 274-G001 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 274-G001, an edge-on spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso274g001-hubble
story: A late-type spiral seen edge-on at the outskirts of the Centaurus A group, glimpsed through a curtain of foreground dust and stars in our own Milky Way.

claims.text: ESO 274-G001 is a late-type spiral galaxy in the outskirts of the Centaurus A (Cen A) group
Its stellar disk is seen edge-on and is obscured by foreground dust and stars of our galaxy
